title: Border Fine Message
scenario: After arrival, a text says you owe an entry tax and must pay immediately.

answers.A: Pay the entry tax through the text link immediately.
answers.B: Reply with your passport number so they can verify the charge.
answers.C: Check the fee with the border authority or official arrival portal.
answers.D: Ask airport or border staff using a known information desk.

explanation: An entry-fee message may exploit the confusion after landing. Official staff and government channels can confirm whether a charge exists.
proTip: Do not prove your identity to the message demanding money.
